verdict.rationale: Gumloop is an agent and automation platform, so execution history and retry-from-failure is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no documentation of execution logs, re-running a failed run, or resuming from the failing step. The only related item is the agent Performance sidebar, which reports "what has it actually been doing". That is a vague activity and cost view, not documented per-execution logs or step-level replay, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
